text: Implemented a primitive NiftiReadPlan that sorts requested voxels, coalesces contiguous and <=4096-byte gaps, splits at 8 MiB, reuses one direct ByteBuffer, decodes selected offsets, scatters to requested order, and keeps overflow-checked Long file positions. Deterministic tests cover full/dense/sparse/split/invalid plans; focused planner+reader tests 7/7 and datasetJVM 58/58. Benchmark command: sbt "datasetJVM/Test/runMain scalafim.dataset.io.NiftiReadBenchmark". Baseline: 200 TR x 50k voxels, 1 window/TR, 200 planned reads instead of 10,000,000, 403,992-byte max buffer, 80,798,400 planned bytes, 0.066 s, 1176.0 MiB/s on this warmed local checkout.
